name: Feather Token (Swan Boat)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Use
powers.text: On water, it becomes a swan-shaped boat 50 ft long that carries you for 24 hours.

summary: On water, it becomes a swan-shaped boat 50 ft long that carries you for 24 hours.
text: This object looks like a feather. Different types of feather tokens exist, each with a different single-use effect. This one is a swan boat token. On water, it becomes a swan-shaped boat 50 ft long that carries you for 24 hours.
